name: Northwest Territories

standard.note: The NWT's famous polar-bear-shaped plate dates to 1970, when Commissioner Stuart Hodgson designed it for the territory's centennial, and it still fits the standard 6-by-12-inch plate size.

plates.title: Veteran licence plate
plates.supports: Certified by the Royal Canadian Legion (Alberta-NWT Command)

notes: The GNWT DMV licence-plate section lists only: replace, veteran, personalized and construction. So the veteran plate is the only specialty passenger plate ($36, available in person only). No plate pictures on idmv.inf.gov.nt.ca. Polar bear facts are from NWT Tourism's spectacularnwt.com story. The candidate standard image there (specnwt.s3.ca-central-1.amazonaws.com/.../NWT-License-Plate-NWTT_0.png, 845x614, ratio 1.38) is the tourism agency's image of a souvenir plate, not the registry's, so it was left null. Other facts from that story: a 1973 RCMP centennial version; 1984 mini bear plates for motorcycles; 1986 'Explore Canada's Arctic' blue-on-white.
